scope: Internal manuscript and presentation review of all 100 sections and 87 written propositions. Chapters 1–5 reviewed by the publication agent; chapters 6–8 reviewed independently by the Lean-audit agent. This is not external referee review or external-reference verification.

mathematical_clarifications.change: State that the atlas family is nonempty.
mathematical_clarifications.reason: The converse proof chooses a reference atlas. For an empty family compatibility is vacuous and does not determine a unique underlying map. The existing Lean mapping already supplies a reference chart.

mathematical_clarifications.change: Require a positive integer delay length h and a positive dimension upper bound d in the sufficient choice h=d.
mathematical_clarifications.reason: The displayed observation stack, warm-up index and last output block require a nonempty history. A zero-length stack has no last block. The later sufficient choice h=d therefore explicitly uses a positive dimension bound.

mathematical_clarifications.change: Require positive integers M and N for the experiment count and trials per word.
mathematical_clarifications.reason: The displayed logarithmic radius uses log(2M/delta)/(2N). Positive counts are needed for that expression and the sample means.

mathematical_clarifications.change: Restrict the positivity-repair mixing weight to [0,1].
mathematical_clarifications.reason: The threshold derived from negative entries is sufficient for convex mixing. Without the upper bound, even a one-state two-outcome instrument A=(1,0), reference N=(1/2,1/2), and mixing weight 3 gives the invalid first branch -1/2.

mathematical_clarifications.change: Make the finite second moment of the scalar u explicit in the affine covariance specialization.
mathematical_clarifications.reason: The affine formula uses Var(u) and its uniform-interval specialization. Requiring finite scalar second moment matches the variance-integrability premise of the formal endpoint. The general matrix covariance identity already assumes square-integrable entries.

routine_edits: Replace obsolete archived-only verification wording with the actual current verification scope.
Synchronize preface, evidence register, coverage table and formal guide with accepted mappings.
Keep release versions, timestamps and implementation history outside the mathematical narrative.
review_limits: No full reconstruction of the unavailable XeLaTeX authoring source.
No claim that written proofs without accepted formal mappings are kernel checked.
No external literature verification or independent external referee certification.

new_guide_review_resolution.finding: An early guide draft described the bounded-test/total-variation inequality in the wrong direction.
new_guide_review_resolution.correction: For tests in [0,1], test integral discrepancies lie below total variation. The observed discrepancy gives a lower error certificate under the simultaneous residual-event hypothesis. This qualification appears in both the editable and rendered guides.

additional_formal_scope_review.preserved_body: No additional mathematical body/proof edits beyond the five listed inherited clarifications. Only the frontmatter coverage counts change in the editable body.
additional_formal_scope_review.guide_grouping: Twenty proposition notes are grouped into nine themes, with exactly-once ID coverage validated by the builder. Separate proposition register statuses and full individual scope notes remain available.
additional_formal_scope_review.trace_norm_caveat: P50 does not automatically identify the predictive base norm with ambient trace norm; this is explicit in the rendered guide and full scope notes.
additional_formal_scope_review.scope_input: Current accepted COVERAGE.json entries P50–P56, including their stated restrictions.
additional_formal_scope_review.review_provenance: Same-team internal manuscript-to-formal mapping review; no external referee certification.
